name: meter
description: Model, effort, context window and subscription usage at the bottom right of Claude Code, on the permission mode's row.

display.title: Subscription windows
display.description: both: the 5-hour and weekly windows side by side. session: only the 5-hour window. week: only the weekly window.

hideCycleHint.title: Hide the mode cycle hint
hideCycleHint.description: Drop "(shift+tab to cycle)" after the permission mode, to leave room for the meter.

hideInterruptHint.title: Hide the interrupt hint
hideInterruptHint.description: Drop "esc to interrupt" from the hint line while Claude works, to leave room for the meter.
